protocol.readerValidation: tw-tools validated v6 ABI/units/start identity and boundary overhead; wave README
protocol.scope: ghostty DOM / xterm 6 DOM. Kernel process CPU energy only, excludes physical GPU/display. Non-atomic endpoint PID/type/start coverage misses entirely short-lived processes. All per-process raw counters and timestamps retained.
protocol.acceptance: Complete actors; same exact final visible text, retained row count and full retained-text SHA; equal public writes/bytes with actual native work and settlement retained; stable PID/type/start family; AC, display, hardware GPU and custody qualified. Report four channels, all directions, median ratios and CPU95 predicate. No candidate KEEP or independently reviewed headline from baseline. Hidden-history style attributes outside oracle.
protocol.failedWindowPolicy: Keep gate-rejected attempts; sole replacement per registered identity; never rerun valid windows
protocol.methodChange: Published shared R06 guards non-GL observer method and labels real drawing canvas. Full retained-history conditions unchanged. Preserve R05 rolling if valid; no mixing packet versions within a balanced set.

native.coverage: Stable endpoint PID/type/start identities. Short-lived processes entirely between endpoints are outside this coverage. Sequential CDP and per-PID counter reads are non-atomic.
